Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Gary Payton?

Gary Payton is 57 years old.

Where was Gary Payton born?

Gary Payton was born in Oakland, California.

When was Gary Payton born?

Gary Payton was born on July 23, 1968.

How tall is Gary Payton?

Gary Payton is 6-4 (193 cm) tall.

How much did Gary Payton weigh when playing?

Gary Payton weighed 180 lbs (81 kg) when playing.

Is Gary Payton in the Hall of Fame?

Gary Payton was inducted to the Hall of Fame as a Player in 2013 (Full List) .

When was Gary Payton drafted?

Gary Payton was drafted by Seattle SuperSonics, 1st round (2nd pick, 2nd overall), 1990 NBA Draft.

What position did Gary Payton play?

Point Guard.

When did Gary Payton retire?

Gary Payton last played in 2007.

What is Gary Payton's net worth?

Gary Payton made at least $104,367,619 playing professional basketball.

How much did Gary Payton make?

Gary Payton made $12,926,493 in 2002.

What did Gary Payton average?

Gary Payton averaged 16.3 points, 3.9 rebounds, and 6.7 assists per game.

How many rings does Gary Payton have?

Gary Payton won one championship.

What schools did Gary Payton attend?

Gary Payton attended Skyline in Oakland, California and Oregon State.

What are Gary Payton's nicknames?

The Glove, GP are nicknames for Gary Payton.
